cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - StorageShelf
cc:Work.dc:description:
StorageShelf can be used to store Typetray
This is a simple shelf box.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes StorageShelf --x 120 --sy '80*2' --sh '60*2' --outside 0 --bottom_edge h --top_edge e --retainer 12 --labels 1 --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes StorageShelf --x --sy --sh --outside --retainer --reference
